title: DeviaProjectConfig
description: Shape of .devia/devia.json, written by `devia init` and read by validate, check, doctor and sync.

deviaVersion.description: Version of the devia package that last wrote this file.

standardVersion.description: Version of the standard pinned in .devia/standard/. `devia sync` updates it.

maturity.description: Declared tier. Agents must never claim a tier the checks do not support.

code.description: Paths that hold the code the memory describes; `devia doctor` compares their history with .devia/.

modules.description: Which parts of the standard apply to this project.

context.description: Target and mode for `devia context`. Absent means the built-in defaults; the selector degrades to them rather than failing.

budget.description: Estimated tokens one task's context should cost. A target, not a floor: the mandatory items are admitted before it is consulted, and `mode` decides what happens when they cost more.

maxTokens.description: The first shipped spelling of `budget`. Still read when `budget` is absent, so an early adopter keeps working untouched.

mode.description: advisory: mandatory items are always delivered whole and the target is reported as exceeded. strict: the target is never exceeded — mandatory items are compressed toward their identifier, never dropped, and a target too small for even that is reported as impossible rather than silently exceeded.

contribution.description: `devia contribute`. Everything local works without this; nothing leaves the machine without it.

enabled.description: false turns the whole feature off, locally included.

identity.description: The GitHub account a contribution is published under. Never the maintainer's, never inferred from the user's git config.

remote.description: owner/repo to file against. Defaults to the devia repository.

waivers.description: Time-boxed exceptions. An expired or undated waiver fails `devia check`.
